mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.6 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in fewer than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.5 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI and a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 50% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market momentum, which increases consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures combined with rising residential investment signals strong household demand, which drives corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, particularly during post-recession recoveries.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in fewer than 50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
